descripcion: Sports hall and courts, athletics, gymnastics and combat sports, gym machine room, sports swimming pool, changing rooms and stands, with their nets, hanging apparatus and water edges.

canasta_minibasket.descripcion: Low hoop on a wheeled, weighted base. You meet the base first, at shin height; the backboard is further forward, above your head.
canasta_minibasket.imagen: Footprint of “Adjustable mini-basketball hoop”: a wide base at the back, a narrow arm to the front and the backboard across its tip, 1.20 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

canasta_techo.descripcion: Sports-hall hoop folded up against the ceiling: backboard, rim and arm hang well above your head. It does not get in the way; unfolded, it comes down to three metres.
canasta_techo.imagen: Footprint of “Ceiling-hung hoop, folded up”: a T shape, 1.80 by 2.50 metres, hanging 3.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ct”.

porteria_futbol_grande.descripcion: Large pitch goal: two round metal posts far apart, the crossbar above your head and a slack net behind that tangles the cane.
porteria_futbol_grande.imagen: Footprint of “Full-size football goal”: a U open at the front, 7.32 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pf”.

porteria_hockey.descripcion: Low hockey goal: a metal frame with a board at floor level inside that knocks like wood when the ball hits it. The roller-hockey one is only hip high.
porteria_hockey.imagen: Footprint of “Hockey goal”: a U open at the front, 1.70 by 0.92 metres, marked with the letters “Ph”.

poste_voleibol.descripcion: Round metal post set into the floor, padded with foam up to chest height. The net runs from it, taut, at head height.
poste_voleibol.imagen: Footprint of “Volleyball post”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Pv”.

red_voleibol.descripcion: Taut net between two posts, from chest height to over two metres. The cane passes underneath without touching it: you meet it with your face or a raised hand.
red_voleibol.imagen: Footprint of “Volleyball net, rigged”: a rectangle, 9.50 by 0.05 metres, hanging 1.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rv”.

poste_badminton.descripcion: Thin post on a heavy wheeled base that juts out towards the court. It is chest high and shifts if pushed.
poste_badminton.imagen: Footprint of “Badminton post on a base”: a T shape, 0.40 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

red_badminton.descripcion: Narrow net between two posts, from waist to chest. There is a gap underneath: the cane goes in and your body meets the net.
red_badminton.imagen: Footprint of “Badminton net, rigged”: a rectangle, 6.10 by 0.04 metres, hanging 0.76 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rb”.

red_tenis.descripcion: Long net across the whole court at hip height, with a metal post at each end. It reaches the ground: the cane finds it and it gives a little.
red_tenis.imagen: Footprint of “Tennis net with posts”: a rectangle, 12.80 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Rt”.

silla_juez_tenis.descripcion: High chair on a metal frame with steps, beside the net post. The seat is above head height; the frame spreads wider at the bottom.
silla_juez_tenis.imagen: Footprint of “Tennis umpire's chair”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.80 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Sj”.

red_padel.descripcion: Ten-metre net splitting the padel court from wall to wall, just below hip height. It reaches the floor and feels soft to the cane.
red_padel.imagen: Footprint of “Padel net with posts”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

pared_cristal_padel.descripcion: Section of thick glass wall three metres high, smooth and cold. It cannot be seen: follow it with your hand; it rings like glass under the cane.
pared_cristal_padel.imagen: Footprint of “Padel court glass wall”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

valla_pista.descripcion: Section of wire mesh on posts, taller than a person. It rattles and jingles when touched; you can trail your hand along it to the gate.
valla_pista.imagen: Footprint of “Court mesh fence”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Vp”.

puerta_pista.descripcion: Mesh gate in the court fence, with a bolt at hand height. Closed, it blocks the way; open, you walk onto the court.
puerta_pista.imagen: Footprint of “Court mesh gate”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

red_parabalones.descripcion: Very tall net on posts behind the goal to stop stray balls. Soft: it gives when pushed and the cane catches in the mesh.
red_parabalones.imagen: Footprint of “Ball-stop netting”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

cortina_divisoria.descripcion: Heavy sheet that comes down from the ceiling and splits the hall in two. Down, it is a soft wall that gives when pushed; rolled up, you walk underneath.
cortina_divisoria.imagen: Footprint of “Sports hall dividing curtain”: a rectangle, 6.00 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

valla_publicitaria.descripcion: Low, sloping board along the edge of the court, at hip height, with a triangular foot behind. Hollow: it sounds like sheet metal.
valla_publicitaria.imagen: Footprint of “Courtside advertising board”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Vp”.

banquillo_cubierto.descripcion: Long bench inside a plastic shelter open at the front. The roof is at head height: duck to get in and sit down.
banquillo_cubierto.imagen: Footprint of “Covered substitutes' bench”: a U open at the front, 4.00 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

banquillo_abierto.descripcion: Long bench with a backrest at the edge of the court, with bags and bottles on the floor in front. Trail your hand along the backrest.
banquillo_abierto.imagen: Footprint of “Open substitutes' bench”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

mesa_anotadores.descripcion: Long table on the sideline between the two benches, with a front panel down to the floor and the scoreboard console on top.
mesa_anotadores.imagen: Footprint of “Scorers' table”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

marcador_electronico.descripcion: Large panel hung high on the end wall. It is not in the way; its horn sounds at the end of each period and tells you where the end of the court is.
marcador_electronico.imagen: Footprint of “Electronic scoreboard with horn”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.12 metres, hanging 3.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Me”.

carro_balones.descripcion: Wheeled wire cage full of balls, waist high. Push it and it rolls; the balls bounce hollow inside.
carro_balones.imagen: Footprint of “Ball trolley”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

conos_fila.descripcion: Plastic cones and discs set out in a row for a drill. Low and light: they tip over or shoot away when kicked.
conos_fila.imagen: Footprint of “Row of training cones”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

pica_base.descripcion: Thin plastic pole stuck in a rubber base, shoulder high. The cane barely touches it; knock it and it falls and rolls.
pica_base.imagen: Footprint of “Slalom pole on a base”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

escalera_agilidad.descripcion: Plastic rungs joined by two straps, laid on the floor like a ladder lying flat. It does not block the way, but foot and cane get tangled in it.
escalera_agilidad.aviso: Agility ladder on the floor: lift your feet.
escalera_agilidad.imagen: Footprint of “Agility ladder on the floor”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ea”.

banderin_corner.descripcion: Flexible pole with a small flag on top, at the corner of the pitch. It bends when touched and springs back.
banderin_corner.imagen: Footprint of “Corner flag”: a circle, 0.05 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

linea_pista.descripcion: Painted or taped line marking the edge of the court. Barely felt underfoot: useful with some sight and, if taped, to the sole of the shoe.
linea_pista.imagen: Footprint of “Court line”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Lp”.

circulo_central.descripcion: Circle painted in the middle of the court. It does not block the way: it marks the centre of the playing area.
circulo_central.imagen: Footprint of “Centre circle”: a circle, 3.60 by 3.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

valla_atletismo.descripcion: Wooden bar on two metal feet pointing towards whoever approaches. Knock it and it tips forward with a clatter.
valla_atletismo.imagen: Footprint of “Athletics hurdle”: a U open at the front, 1.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Va”.

minivallas.descripcion: Row of small plastic hurdles below knee height, a stride apart. Light: they tip over underfoot and the cane drags them along.
minivallas.imagen: Footprint of “Mini training hurdles”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 0.60 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

taco_salida.descripcion: Metal rail pinned to the track with two sloping pedals. Very low: easy to trip over just behind the start line.
taco_salida.imagen: Footprint of “Starting block”: a central rail with a pedal on each side, one further forward than the other, 0.40 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Ts”.

ria_obstaculos.descripcion: Water pit on the bend of the track: the ground drops suddenly into knee-deep water. It does not block the way, but you fall in.
ria_obstaculos.aviso: Steeplechase water jump: there is a water pit ahead.
ria_obstaculos.imagen: Footprint of “Steeplechase water jump”: a rectangle, 3.66 by 3.66 metres, marked with the letters “Ro”.

obstaculo_fijo.descripcion: Thick wooden beam on two wide, heavy feet, at hip height. It neither moves nor tips: like walking into a railing.
obstaculo_fijo.imagen: Footprint of “Steeplechase barrier”: a long narrow beam with a foot across each end, 3.96 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Of”.

bordillo_pista_atletismo.descripcion: Aluminium strip four fingers high separating lane one from the grass. Step on or over it; the cane can follow it as a guide.
bordillo_pista_atletismo.imagen: Footprint of “Athletics track inner kerb”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

foso_longitud.descripcion: Rectangle of loose sand at the end of the runway, level with the ground. Your foot sinks in and your steps go quiet.
foso_longitud.aviso: Sand pit: the ground gives way.
foso_longitud.imagen: Footprint of “Long jump pit”: a rectangle, 2.75 by 9.00 metres, marked with the letters “Fl”.

colchon_altura.descripcion: Huge block of foam covered in canvas, hip high. Soft: the cane sinks into it without a sound.
colchon_altura.imagen: Footprint of “High jump landing mat”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

saltometro.descripcion: Two thin posts on metal bases with a bar resting between them that falls at the slightest touch. The cane passes under the bar without touching it.
saltometro.imagen: Footprint of “High jump stands with bar”: two bases at the ends and a thin bar between them, 4.20 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

cajetin_pertiga.descripcion: Metal box sunk into the ground at the end of the runway, wedge-shaped. It does not block the way: your foot or the cane tip drops into it.
cajetin_pertiga.aviso: Pole vault box: there is a hole in the ground.
cajetin_pertiga.imagen: Footprint of “Pole vault box”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

jaula_lanzamientos.descripcion: Very tall net hung from posts around the throwing circle, with an open mouth at the front. Trail your hand round the outside; inside, the floor is concrete.
jaula_lanzamientos.imagen: Footprint of “Throwing cage”: a ring with an opening at the front, 7.00 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Jl”.

circulo_lanzamiento.descripcion: Circle of smooth concrete ringed by an iron hoop that barely sticks up. You feel the change of surface and the hoop underfoot.
circulo_lanzamiento.imagen: Footprint of “Throwing circle”: a circle, 2.13 by 2.13 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

contenedor_peso.descripcion: Curved wooden board, a hand's width high, fixed to the front edge of the shot put circle. A low, solid trip hazard.
contenedor_peso.imagen: Footprint of “Shot put stop board”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 1.21 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

tapiz_gimnasia.descripcion: Sprung, carpeted floor one small step higher than the hall floor. It gives underfoot, bounces a little and muffles your steps.
tapiz_gimnasia.imagen: Footprint of “Gymnastics floor”: a rectangle, 12.00 by 12.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tg”.

tatami.descripcion: Floor of interlocking foam tiles, firm but soft. Walked on barefoot; its edge is a small step.
tatami.imagen: Footprint of “Martial arts mat area”: a rectangle, 8.00 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

quitamiedos.descripcion: Foam mattress two hand-widths thick, lying under an apparatus or standing against the wall. Soft: the cane sinks in silently.
quitamiedos.imagen: Footprint of “Thick crash mat”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Qu”.

carro_colchonetas.descripcion: Wheeled platform loaded waist-high with thin mats. The edges are soft; the castors stick out underneath.
carro_colchonetas.imagen: Footprint of “Trolley of stacked mats”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 2.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

caballo_arcos.descripcion: Long leather-covered body on a metal stand, chest high, with two handles on top. Hollow below: the cane only touches the stand.
caballo_arcos.imagen: Footprint of “Pommel horse”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

barra_equilibrio.descripcion: Narrow five-metre padded beam on two feet. The beginners' one is a hand's width off the floor and easy to trip over; the competition one is chest high.
barra_equilibrio.imagen: Footprint of “Balance beam”: a long narrow beam with a foot across each end, 5.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

paralelas.descripcion: Two wooden bars at the same height, above chest level, on four posts and a metal base at floor level that is easy to trip on.
paralelas.imagen: Footprint of “Parallel bars”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

paralelas_asimetricas.descripcion: Two bars at different heights, the upper one out of reach, held to the floor by diagonal cables. The cables are the first thing the cane finds.
paralelas_asimetricas.imagen: Footprint of “Uneven bars with guy wires”: a rectangle with cut corners, 4.00 by 5.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

barra_fija.descripcion: A very high steel bar between two posts, with four taut cables running diagonally down to the floor. The cables cross your path at leg and chest height.
barra_fija.imagen: Footprint of “Horizontal bar with guy wires”: a diamond, 4.00 by 5.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bf”.

anillas.descripcion: Two wooden rings hung from the ceiling on straps, at face height. The cane misses them; they swing when brushed.
anillas.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging rings”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “An”.

minitramp.descripcion: Small, tilted trampette at knee height: a metal frame with a sheet stretched on springs.
minitramp.imagen: Footprint of “Mini trampoline”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.10 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

cama_elastica.descripcion: Large metal frame at waist height with a taut bed in the middle and padded edges. Hollow underneath.
cama_elastica.imagen: Footprint of “Competition trampoline”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 2.91 by 5.05 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

trampolin_batida.descripcion: Curved, carpeted wooden board, wedge-shaped, rising to shin height. Left in front of the vaulting box or horse: a low trip hazard.
trampolin_batida.imagen: Footprint of “Springboard”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

barra_ballet.descripcion: Round wooden rail running along the wall at hip height, a hand's width out. The cane passes underneath; it works as a handrail.
barra_ballet.imagen: Footprint of “Wall ballet barre”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.20 metres, hanging 0.85 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bb”.

ring_boxeo.descripcion: Square platform raised to hip height, with a padded post at each corner and four taut ropes all round. You climb in by a corner step.
ring_boxeo.imagen: Footprint of “Boxing ring”: a rectangle with cut corners, 6.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rb”.

saco_boxeo.descripcion: Heavy leather bag hung on a chain, from thigh to head. The cane passes under it; hit it and it swings away and comes back.
saco_boxeo.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging punch bag”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sb”.

saco_pie.descripcion: Padded column on a round water-filled base. Hit it and it tilts and rights itself; the base is wider than the bag.
saco_pie.imagen: Footprint of “Free-standing punch bag”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

pera_boxeo.descripcion: Round board fixed to the wall at head height, with a leather speed bag hanging beneath. The cane does not detect it.
pera_boxeo.imagen: Footprint of “Speed bag with platform”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.60 by 0.65 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pb”.

cuerda_trepar.descripcion: Thick rope hanging from the ceiling almost to the floor, sometimes knotted. It swings away when touched and comes back.
cuerda_trepar.imagen: Footprint of “Climbing rope”: a circle, 0.05 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

rocodromo.descripcion: Wall with resin holds and a thick mat at its foot. You step on the mat first; the wall may lean outwards at head height.
rocodromo.imagen: Footprint of “Climbing wall with mat”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ro”.

diana_arco.descripcion: Round block of pressed straw resting on a wooden easel, at chest height. The legs spread out behind.
diana_arco.imagen: Footprint of “Archery target on a stand”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.30 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Da”.

cinta_correr.descripcion: Long, low deck with a moving belt and, at the front, a handrail with the console at chest height. Running, it hums and you hear the footfalls; the belt throws off anything stepping on it from behind.
cinta_correr.imagen: Footprint of “Treadmill”: a rectangle, 0.85 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

eliptica.descripcion: Machine with two large pedals and two long arms swinging back and forth at chest height. In use, the arms strike anyone passing too close.
eliptica.imagen: Footprint of “Cross trainer”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “El”.

bici_estatica.descripcion: Fixed bike with saddle, handlebars and a closed housing at the front. The pedals stick out at shin height on both sides.
bici_estatica.imagen: Footprint of “Exercise bike”: a narrow front-to-back body with the pedals sticking out on both sides halfway along, 0.55 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

bici_spinning.descripcion: Fixed bike with a bare frame and a heavy iron flywheel at the front that keeps spinning by itself. The handlebars are low and point forward.
bici_spinning.imagen: Footprint of “Indoor cycling bike”: a narrow front-to-back body with the pedals sticking out on both sides halfway along, 0.55 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bs”.

remo.descripcion: A long rail a hand's width off the floor with a sliding seat and a fan wheel at one end. Low and long: easy to trip over the rail.
remo.imagen: Footprint of “Rowing machine”: a T shape, 0.60 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Re”.

escaladora.descripcion: Tall machine with a never-ending staircase and handrails at the sides. You get on from the back; the steps move by themselves.
escaladora.imagen: Footprint of “Stair climber”: a rectangle, 0.85 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

banco_press.nombre: Bench press with rack and bar
banco_press.descripcion: Narrow bench to lie on with two uprights at its head and an iron bar across at hip height. The bar ends stick out well past each side and the cane passes under them.
banco_press.imagen: Footprint of “Bench press with rack and bar”: a T shape, 2.20 by 1.70 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

rack_sentadillas.descripcion: Cage of four steel posts with a bar resting at shoulder height. The bar sticks out on both sides, right where your face goes.
rack_sentadillas.imagen: Footprint of “Squat rack”: a frame in the middle and a thin bar crossing it and sticking out on both sides, 2.20 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rs”.

multipower.descripcion: Wide steel frame with a bar that slides up and down two rails. The bar stays where the last user left it: at knee, chest or forehead height.
multipower.imagen: Footprint of “Smith machine”: a rectangle, 2.10 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Mu”.

cruce_poleas.descripcion: Two weight-stack towers more than three metres apart, joined by a beam at the top and a flat base below. A cable with a handle hangs from each tower at any height.
cruce_poleas.imagen: Footprint of “Cable crossover machine”: two towers at the ends joined by a beam, 3.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

jalon_dorsal.descripcion: Weight-stack tower with a seat in front and, hanging from a cable, a wide bar at head height for anyone walking up to it.
jalon_dorsal.imagen: Footprint of “Lat pulldown machine”: a T shape, 1.20 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Jd”.

prensa_piernas.descripcion: Large sloping machine: a nearly reclined seat at the bottom and, above, a plate-loaded platform sliding down two rails.
prensa_piernas.imagen: Footprint of “Leg press”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.10 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

extension_cuadriceps.descripcion: Seat with a backrest and a padded roller in front of the shins; the weight stack stands to one side. The roller lifts and hangs at knee height.
extension_cuadriceps.imagen: Footprint of “Leg extension machine”: an L shape, 1.10 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

contractora.descripcion: Seat against a weight stack with two padded arms that open like doors at chest height. Open, they take up twice the width.
contractora.imagen: Footprint of “Pec deck machine”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.30 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

multiestacion.descripcion: Several machines in one: a central weight stack with seats, arms and pulleys sticking out on all four sides. Walk round it slowly, hand in front.
multiestacion.imagen: Footprint of “Multi-gym”: a cross, 1.90 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mu”.

jaula_funcional.descripcion: Row of steel posts joined at the top by pull-up bars, with hooks sticking out at chest height. You walk between the posts; the bars are overhead.
jaula_funcional.imagen: Footprint of “Functional training rig”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 4.50 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Jf”.

banco_plano.descripcion: Narrow, low padded bench with no back, on splayed metal legs. Left loose among the dumbbells, at knee height.
banco_plano.imagen: Footprint of “Flat weight bench”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

banco_inclinado.descripcion: Padded bench with its backrest raised like a ramp to chest height. Wider at the feet than at the seat.
banco_inclinado.imagen: Footprint of “Adjustable incline bench”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.65 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bi”.

mancuernero.descripcion: Long steel rack with two or three sloping tiers loaded with pairs of dumbbells. The iron heads stick out at knee and hip height.
mancuernero.imagen: Footprint of “Dumbbell rack”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

soporte_discos.descripcion: Steel post with short arms at several heights, loaded with iron plates. The plates stick out like wheels on each side.
soporte_discos.imagen: Footprint of “Weight plate tree”: a cross, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Sd”.

barra_olimpica.nombre: Loaded Olympic bar on the floor
barra_olimpica.descripcion: Iron bar over two metres long lying on the floor with large plates at its ends. Low, long and thin in the middle: easy to trip over; push it and it rolls.
barra_olimpica.imagen: Footprint of “Loaded Olympic bar on the floor”: a thin bar with a stack of plates at each end, 2.20 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Bo”.

plataforma_halterofilia.descripcion: Wood and rubber platform a finger's width above the floor, where bars are dropped. You feel the small step and the change of surface.
plataforma_halterofilia.imagen: Footprint of “Weightlifting platform”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ph”.

kettlebells.descripcion: Iron balls with handles lined up on the floor by the wall. Below knee height and heavy: your foot hits them and they do not move.
kettlebells.imagen: Footprint of “Row of kettlebells”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ke”.

estante_balones_medicinales.descripcion: Narrow metal tower with heavy balls on sloping shelves, up to chest height. Pull one out and another may roll to the floor.
estante_balones_medicinales.imagen: Footprint of “Medicine ball rack”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

cajon_pliometrico.descripcion: Hollow wooden box, knee to thigh high, left loose in the jumping area. It sounds like a drum.
cajon_pliometrico.imagen: Footprint of “Plyometric jump box”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

fitball.descripcion: Large inflated rubber ball, knee to thigh high. Touch it and it rolls away; the cane bounces off it.
fitball.imagen: Footprint of “Exercise ball”: a circle, 0.65 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Fi”.

step.descripcion: Plastic platform a hand's width high with a rough top. Left around the room after class: a low trip hazard.
step.imagen: Footprint of “Aerobic step”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.10 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “St”.

esterillas_apiladas.descripcion: Pile of foam mats on top of one another, by the wall. Soft and low: the cane sinks in slightly.
esterillas_apiladas.imagen: Footprint of “Stack of exercise mats”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ea”.

esterilla_extendida.descripcion: Foam mat someone has left laid out. It does not block the way: it feels soft underfoot and may slide.
esterilla_extendida.imagen: Footprint of “Exercise mat laid out”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ee”.

cuerdas_batida.descripcion: Two ropes as thick as an arm, anchored to the wall and laid out on the floor. They do not block the way, but foot and cane trip on them.
cuerdas_batida.aviso: Ropes on the floor: lift your feet.
cuerdas_batida.imagen: Footprint of “Battle ropes on the floor”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

correas_suspension.descripcion: Two straps with handles hanging from the ceiling or a bar, from hip to head. The cane passes underneath; they tangle round your arm.
correas_suspension.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging suspension straps”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cs”.

espejo_sala.descripcion: Large mirror covering the wall almost from the floor. Smooth and cold; with some sight, the room seems to carry on.
espejo_sala.imagen: Footprint of “Gym wall mirror”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.04 metres, hanging 0.15 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Es”.

dispensador_papel.descripcion: Plastic box screwed to the wall or a pillar at chest height, holding the paper roll and the spray. It sticks out and the cane gives no warning.
dispensador_papel.imagen: Footprint of “Paper and sanitiser dispenser”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Dp”.

bascula_columna.descripcion: Low platform to stand on and a column with the display at chest height. The platform sticks out at floor level in front.
bascula_columna.imagen: Footprint of “Column scale”: a rectangle, 0.35 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

fuente_botellas.descripcion: Steel fountain hung on the wall at waist height, with a recess for a bottle. Nothing below it: the cane does not find it.
fuente_botellas.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted bottle filler”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.40 metres, hanging 0.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Fb”.

mostrador_gimnasio.descripcion: L-shaped counter at chest height, with a lower section and the wristband reader on the corner, which beeps when a card is passed.
mostrador_gimnasio.imagen: Footprint of “Gym reception desk”: an L shape, 2.80 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mg”.

vaso_piscina.descripcion: The pool water, level with the surround. There is no railing: one more step and you fall in. You hear the water lapping the edge and falling into the gutter.
vaso_piscina.aviso: Pool edge: stop. There is deep water ahead.
vaso_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Swimming pool tank”: a rectangle, 12.50 by 25.00 metres, marked with the letters “Vp”.

rebosadero.descripcion: Narrow channel covered with a plastic grating running round the pool. Felt under a bare foot and with the cane tip: the water is one step away.
rebosadero.aviso: Overflow gutter: the water's edge is one step away.
rebosadero.imagen: Footprint of “Overflow gutter with grating”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Re”.

murete_vaso.descripcion: Tiled edge rising to knee height round the pool. It blocks the way and warns of the water; you can sit on it and swing your legs in.
murete_vaso.imagen: Footprint of “Raised pool wall”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Mv”.

rampa_piscina.descripcion: Gentle ramp with handrails on both sides going gradually into the water. The floor slopes down and the water rises up your legs.
rampa_piscina.aviso: Pool ramp: the floor slopes down into the water.
rampa_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Pool access ramp”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 7.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

poyete_salida.descripcion: Pedestal with its platform sloping towards the water, right on the edge, knee to thigh high. One per lane, in a row.
poyete_salida.imagen: Footprint of “Starting block”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

trampolin_piscina.descripcion: Long, springy board jutting out over the water, with a ladder and handrails at its base. The one-metre board is at hip height.
trampolin_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Diving springboard”: a T shape, 1.20 by 4.80 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

torre_saltos.descripcion: Concrete tower with stairs and platforms at several heights jutting out over the diving pit. At ground level it is a solid block to walk round.
torre_saltos.imagen: Footprint of “Diving tower”: a T shape, 4.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ts”.

corchera_tendida.descripcion: String of plastic floats separating two lanes from one end of the pool to the other. It is in the water: you touch it with your hand while swimming.
corchera_tendida.imagen: Footprint of “Lane rope, rigged”: a rectangle, 0.15 by 25.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

corchera_carrete.nombre: Lane rope on its storage reel
corchera_carrete.descripcion: Huge wheeled reel on which the lane ropes are wound, taller than waist height, parked on the pool surround.
corchera_carrete.imagen: Footprint of “Lane rope on its storage reel”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

jaula_material.nombre: Cage of kickboards, noodles and pull buoys
jaula_material.descripcion: Wheeled mesh trolley full of foam equipment. The noodles stick out of the top, soft, at face height.
jaula_material.imagen: Footprint of “Cage of kickboards, noodles and pull buoys”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Jm”.

flotadores_colgados.descripcion: Row of wall hooks with foam vests and belts hanging from hip to head height. Soft; the cane passes underneath.
flotadores_colgados.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging buoyancy vests and belts”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.30 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Fc”.

escalerilla_piscina.descripcion: Two curved steel tubes rising from the edge to waist height; between them the rungs go down into the water. Cold and wet.
escalerilla_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Pool ladder”: a U open at the front, 0.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

silla_socorrista.descripcion: Chair on a tower with steps, its seat above head height. At the bottom the legs spread wider than the seat.
silla_socorrista.imagen: Footprint of “Lifeguard high chair”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.90 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ss”.

aro_salvavidas.descripcion: Rigid ring hung on a hook at chest height, with a coiled rope. It sticks out a hand's width and the cane passes underneath.
aro_salvavidas.imagen: Footprint of “Lifebuoy on the wall”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 0.12 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “As”.

pertiga_rescate.descripcion: Long aluminium pole with a hook at its tip, resting horizontally on two brackets at head height.
pertiga_rescate.imagen: Footprint of “Rescue pole on the wall”: a rectangle, 3.50 by 0.08 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pr”.

grua_piscina.descripcion: Steel column at the edge with an arm from which a plastic chair hangs. The chair swings out over the water and lowers; at rest it sits over the surround.
grua_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Hydraulic pool lift”: an L shape, 0.70 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

ducha_piscina.descripcion: Column with a push button at hand height and a shower head above. Press it and water falls for half a minute, leaving the floor around it wet.
ducha_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Poolside entry shower”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Dp”.

pediluvio.descripcion: Dip in the floor filled with a finger's depth of water that you must cross to reach the pool. You feel the step down and the water on your feet.
pediluvio.aviso: Footbath: the floor steps down and there is water.
pediluvio.imagen: Footprint of “Footbath”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

banco_piscina.descripcion: Backless plastic bench by the wall, with towels on top and flip-flops underneath. Smooth and sometimes wet.
banco_piscina.imagen: Footprint of “Poolside bench”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

tobogan_acuatico.descripcion: Fibreglass chute with water running down it, a ladder behind and the exit over the pool. You hear the water running down.
tobogan_acuatico.imagen: Footprint of “Water slide”: an L shape, 1.50 by 4.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

jacuzzi.descripcion: Small tank of warm water sunk into the floor, with a bench inside. It bubbles constantly: you hear it before reaching the edge.
jacuzzi.aviso: Edge of the whirlpool: there are steps down into the water.
jacuzzi.imagen: Footprint of “Whirlpool spa”: an octagon, 2.50 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ja”.

sauna.descripcion: Cabin of wooden boards with a self-closing door. Inside it is very hot, with tiered benches; the stone heater burns.
sauna.imagen: Footprint of “Sauna cabin”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

bano_turco.descripcion: Tiled cabin with a glass door, full of steam. You hear the nozzle hissing; the benches and the floor are wet and hot.
bano_turco.imagen: Footprint of “Steam room”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.50 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

banco_doble_vestuario.nombre: Double changing bench with central coat rail
banco_doble_vestuario.descripcion: Island bench with a seat on each side and, in the middle, a tall frame with hooks and a bag shelf at head height. You can walk all the way round it.
banco_doble_vestuario.imagen: Footprint of “Double changing bench with central coat rail”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Bd”.

banco_simple_vestuario.descripcion: Slatted bench with no back on metal legs, at knee height, with trainers and bags underneath.
banco_simple_vestuario.imagen: Footprint of “Plain changing bench”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Bs”.

percha_alta_vestuario.nombre: High changing-room hook rail with shelf
percha_alta_vestuario.descripcion: Mesh shelf with a row of hooks beneath, fixed to the wall at head height above the bench. It sticks out a good hand's width.
percha_alta_vestuario.imagen: Footprint of “High changing-room hook rail with shelf”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

taquillas_con_banco.descripcion: Tall sheet-metal lockers mounted on a continuous bench that sticks out in front at knee height. You meet the bench first; the doors clang.
taquillas_con_banco.imagen: Footprint of “Changing-room locker block with bench”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

taquillas_bajas.descripcion: Half-height sheet-metal lockers, waist high, with a flat top where bags are left.
taquillas_bajas.imagen: Footprint of “Low changing-room locker block”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

cabina_cambio.descripcion: Cubicle of smooth panels with a door and a small bench inside. The panels stop short of the floor: the cane goes a hand's width underneath.
cabina_cambio.imagen: Footprint of “Changing cubicle”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

duchas_colectivas.descripcion: Open area with several shower heads on the wall and the floor sloping to a drain. It does not block the way: the floor is wet and slippery.
duchas_colectivas.aviso: Shower area: the floor is wet.
duchas_colectivas.imagen: Footprint of “Open row of showers”: a rectangle, 3.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Dc”.

duchas_separadores.descripcion: Row of showers divided by panels sticking out from the wall like the teeth of a comb. You walk straight in between two panels.
duchas_separadores.imagen: Footprint of “Changing-room showers with partitions”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 2.70 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Ds”.

ducha_adaptada.nombre: Accessible changing-room shower with fold-down seat
ducha_adaptada.descripcion: Plastic seat folding down from the wall at knee height, with grab bars on either side. Folded, it barely sticks out.
ducha_adaptada.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible changing-room shower with fold-down seat”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, hanging 0.45 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Da”.

tarima_rejilla.descripcion: Plastic or slatted grating laid on the floor in front of the showers to keep feet out of the water. You feel the small step and it sounds hollow.
tarima_rejilla.imagen: Footprint of “Changing-room duckboard”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

secamanos_vestuario.descripcion: Metal box on the wall at chest height that blows air when you put your hands under it. The cane passes beneath without touching it.
secamanos_vestuario.imagen: Footprint of “Changing-room hand dryer”: a rectangle, 0.28 by 0.22 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sv”.

centrifugadora.descripcion: Steel tub fixed to the wall at waist height. Put your swimsuit in, press the lid down and it spins with a whine for a few seconds.
centrifugadora.imagen: Footprint of “Swimsuit spin dryer”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.35 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ce”.

tocador_vestuario.descripcion: Long shelf cantilevered from the wall at waist height, with no legs and a mirror above. The cane goes underneath; your hip finds it.
tocador_vestuario.imagen: Footprint of “Changing-room vanity shelf with mirror”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tv”.

camilla_masaje.descripcion: Padded table with a face hole at one end, on folding legs. Hollow underneath.
camilla_masaje.imagen: Footprint of “Massage table”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

botiquin_pared.descripcion: Small sheet-metal cabinet hung on the wall at face height, with a door that clangs. The cane does not detect it.
botiquin_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Sports facility wall first-aid cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.18 metres, hanging 1.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bp”.

grada_hormigon.descripcion: Wide, high concrete steps where spectators sit: each row is a knee-high step. You climb it like a staircase with very long treads.
grada_hormigon.imagen: Footprint of “Section of concrete terrace”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Gh”.

grada_telescopica.descripcion: Seating that stores like a drawer: folded, it is a tall, flat cabinet against the wall; unfolded, stepped rows of seats reaching out onto the court.
grada_telescopica.imagen: Footprint of “Retractable seating”: a rectangle, 6.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Gt”.

grada_portatil.descripcion: Three or four rows of planks on a tubular frame, open underneath and behind. It rings like metal and shakes as you climb.
grada_portatil.imagen: Footprint of “Portable metal bleachers”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

fila_asientos_grada.descripcion: Hard plastic seats bolted in a row on the terrace, side by side. Tip-up ones spring up by themselves and leave more room to pass.
fila_asientos_grada.imagen: Footprint of “Row of stand seats”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Fa”.

antepecho_cristal.descripcion: Glass panel at chest height along the edge of the stand, with a metal handrail on top. It cannot be seen; trail your hand along the handrail.
antepecho_cristal.imagen: Footprint of “Stand glass balustrade”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

vomitorio.descripcion: Passage cutting through the stand: a short corridor between two walls with a low ceiling, emerging halfway up the seating. There are steps on the far side.
vomitorio.aviso: Vomitory: you are coming out onto the stand, there are steps.
vomitorio.imagen: Footprint of “Vomitory”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Vo”.

tunel_vestuarios.descripcion: Canvas corridor on hoops leading from the stand to the edge of the pitch. Inside, sound is deadened and the walls give when touched.
tunel_vestuarios.aviso: Players' tunnel: narrow passage between canvas walls.
tunel_vestuarios.imagen: Footprint of “Players' tunnel”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tv”.
